why_text: The Walls had been taken for the edge of the world.
Life in the zone gives children a reason to chase Warrior status.
Learning that the wider world exists set Paradis against it.
The destruction of Wall Maria forced human retreat and prompted the Colossal and Armored Titans' subsequent assault on Trost.
The loss of Wall Maria established the long-term military objective to reclaim Shiganshina District.
Eren's public Titan transformation at Trost exposed his powers to Reiner and Bertholdt, ultimately prompting their confession.
The discovery of Titan shifters within the military spurred the Royal Government to capture Eren, sparking the coup d'état.
Overthrowing the monarchy and acquiring Titan hardening enabled the Survey Corps to launch the operation to retake Wall Maria.
Defeating the Warriors and securing Shiganshina granted the Survey Corps access to Grisha Yeager's basement.
Marley's defeat at Shiganshina and loss of two Titan powers prompted the Mid-East Allied Forces to declare war.
Uncovering the global hostility documented in the journals foreshadowed Marley's worldwide coalition against Paradis.
The rise of anti-Titan weaponry during the war pressured Marley to reclaim the Founding Titan through Tybur's coalition.
Willy Tybur's declaration of war served as Eren's planned cue to transform and assault the Liberio festival.
Eren's unauthorized attack and subsequent arrest fractured the military, inspiring the Yeagerists to stage a coup.
Extracting Zeke Yeager from Liberio brought royal blood to Paradis, establishing the prerequisite for physical contact.
The Yeagerists overthrew military command and defended the brothers from Marleyan forces until they made physical contact.
Physical contact unlocked the Paths, allowing Eren to bypass the royal vow and convince Ymir to unleash the Wall Titans.
The catastrophic march of the Wall Titans forced the remaining Survey Corps and Marleyan Warriors to forge a truce.
The imminent destruction of humanity under the Rumbling necessitated the final confrontation at Fort Salta.
The unified alliance secured the Azumabito flying boat to intercept Eren and engage his Founding Titan in the final battle.
